name: skyclone
title: skyclone
blurb: An unofficial clone of the bsky.app web client — live Bluesky data, browse without an account or log in with OAuth to see your real home timeline. Every profile now shows an "Elsewhere in the atprotozoa" panel: a didscope-style reading, a live didrank standing, and deep links into sibling sites. Not affiliated with Bluesky PBC.
